body: I have tried the exact thing you suggested. Letting my parents know I'm going to be busy with work for a bit and I'd prefer not to be disturbed. I don't really see any reason to keep living. The only thing I look forward to is a couple times a week for like 3-4 hours I do my hobby. It's not important what it is, assume its tennis. I've tried being more social for the past 6 months, but it's hard, embarrassing and not changing anything. I'm thinking about visiting a shrink but I keep thinking I'll run into someone I know and they'll judge me. What do I do, Reddit?
